__broaden__.አብ: አብ — father (the Father) · a father in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ)
__broaden__.ኢኮነ: ኮነ — he did not become (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n) · 'is not' with a predicate (ዝሰ ኢኮነ አምላክ 'this is not a god'; ch. 13)
__broaden__.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
